limits: Only original report byte counts, hashes, artifact-relative names and source/run bindings are committed here. Raw JSON content is not committed.
Automatic approval review rejected raw exports containing opaque session/review tokens and excessive runner/input records. Focused receipts omit those records.
Original reports and captures require the existing Actions artifacts, which expire on 2026-11-08. A hash alone cannot reconstruct expired content.
Local originals were preserved during preparation but are not a durable public download.
Repeated and partial gates are retained as history, not additional unique test coverage.
